summary: Frontend-only e2e verification of the 'portrait locked' bug fix on character 'Regred Maggot' (c16a362d-9841-4954-8f70-0dfe02dfe303). Logged in as Maestro, opened the character sheet, confirmed the lock icon is gone, the visible 'Cambiar retrato' button is present, clicking it triggered POST /api/portraits/generate (200), the preview modal appeared with the new image, 'Guardar' fired PATCH /api/characters/{id} (200) with toast 'Retrato guardado en la ficha (definitivo).' On reload, the 'Cambiar retrato' button is still visible — the original bug no longer reproduces.
critical_code_review_comments: CharacterHeader.jsx top-of-file docstring still says 'Si portrait_locked está activo, el retrato NO puede cambiarse (definitivo).' This contradicts the new behaviour (lock removed); update the comment to avoid confusing future maintainers.

saveDraft sends portrait_locked: true on every save, which re-introduces the legacy flag in the document. Since the UI no longer honours the lock anyway, consider sending portrait_locked: false (or omitting it) so DB state matches actual UX semantics.
Backfill suggestion: 8 existing characters still have portrait_locked=true in DB. They behave correctly with the new UI, but a one-off migration to clear the flag would keep data consistent.
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing locked character 'Regred Maggot'. NOTE: saving overwrote the existing portrait with a freshly AI-generated one (real GPT-Image-1 call consumed credits).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug verified fixed end-to-end. The portrait-change flow works for a previously locked character: button visible without hover, generation succeeds in ~30s, preview modal saves via PATCH /api/characters/{id} (200), and the change-portrait button remains available after reload. Only follow-up is the stale docstring + the portrait_locked:true still being written on save (cosmetic/DB consistency).
rca of the issue: Original bug: CharacterHeader showed a permanent padlock and short-circuited generatePortrait when character.portrait_locked was true, so 8 legacy characters could never change their portrait. Fix removes the lock check in generatePortrait, replaces the padlock UI with an always-present overlay button (character-regen-portrait-btn) plus a hover-independent visible button (character-change-portrait-btn labelled 'Cambiar retrato' when an image already exists). Verified live: lock icon gone, button visible & clickable, POST /api/portraits/generate fires, preview modal appears, Guardar persists via PATCH (200) and the button is still available after reload.
